description: Pi-model with temperature-dependent R(T), skin-effect correction, and IEEE 738 thermal ampacity limit.

unit.name: Generic 230 kV ACSR 'Drake' Overhead Transmission Line
unit.source: IEEE Std 738-2012; IEC 60287-1-1 (2006); Glover, Sarma, Overbye (2012) 5th ed.; Morgan (1978).

R_dc_pu_per_km.note: DC resistance at 20 degC per km (ACSR Drake, 230 kV base)

alpha_R_per_K.note: Aluminium temp coefficient of resistance (IEC 60228, Class 2)

skin_factor.note: R_ac/R_dc ratio at 50 Hz for stranded ACSR (typical 1.01-1.04, Glover 2012 Table 4.1)

D_conductor_m.note: ACSR Drake outer diameter = 28.14 mm (IEEE 738 Table B.1)

T_conductor_max_C.note: Continuous max conductor temperature (standard ACSR limit; 100 degC high-temp)

emissivity.note: Surface emissivity (weathered ACSR, IEEE 738 Table 2 range 0.23-0.91)

solar_irradiance_W_m2.note: Clear sky solar irradiance (global horizontal, summer)

wind_speed_m_s.note: IEEE 738 standard reference wind (2 ft/s perpendicular)

I_rated_A.note: ACSR Drake rated current at 75 degC, 25 degC ambient, wind=0.61 m/s (IEEE 738)
